article-a.title: Use a with The vowel-ending pattern
article-a.bodyMarkdown:
Course 1 already taught you that the definite article follows the noun. Now choose the form. Use **a** when the noun ends in a non-nasal vowel sound:

- **tifi a** — the girl
- **flè a** — the flower

Listen to the end of the noun before choosing the article.

article-la.title: Use la with The consonant-ending examples
article-la.bodyMarkdown:
Use **la** with these examples ending in a consonant:

- **bèf la** — the cow
- **chat la** — the cat
- **kòb la** — the money

Do not translate “the” first. Notice the end of the Kreyòl noun.

a-vs-la.title: Let the noun ending guide the choice
a-vs-la.bodyMarkdown:
Compare the two article patterns:

- a follows examples ending in a non-nasal vowel.
- la follows examples such as bèf, chat, and kòb.

You already know where the article goes. The new skill is choosing its form.
